title: Pull & Wrists
description: This was really meditative. Slow and focused. Plenty of rest between sets. I think I need to start thinking of these workouts as an opportunity to maintain calm, even breathing and heart rates while working my muscles. That is, I should avoid rushing and getting my heart rate really high. Focus on quality sets and form, and maintain the low cardio intensity and stress needed for it.
